question:
Study the given diagram carefully and answer the questions. The numbers in different sections indicate the number of persons. How many people are educated and rich but not famous?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49dd42213794f5af5523cdf3be0efd6fef966a78015d2bf5f7780b53204a6e86.png]
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b81566c5a0a321152db2de5976c73c3868239a80e1edc306a9e17aab3fca6d4b.png] 

The shaded area shows "the educated and rich but not famous peoples".

So, there are 3 peoples are educated and rich but not famous.

Hence, the correct answer is "3".
